designBrief: Playful mascot-branded cafe at Longhaus, Upper Thomson, Singapore. Palette from the real logo (sage background, coral mascot shirt) and the real black storefront signage. Baloo 2 for headings (matches the rounded mascot illustration), Inter for body. Single-page, playful but straightforward, matching a commercially savvy social-media-fluent cafe chain rather than an artisanal boutique. Signature element: a 3-dot 'tapioca pearl' cluster echoing the boba drink the real mascot holds, used sparingly as a divider/bullet motif.
